svg.title: Accessible experiment interface — editable design-system card
svg.desc: A light-gray design card with black text, white form fields and status banners, blue primary buttons with an underlined hover label, black secondary buttons, green information icons, red warning icons for errors and offline status, and raised grayscale keyboard keycaps. Information uses exact crosshair green #008000; warnings use exact crosshair red #FF0000. All icon symbols are white, 26 px bold, and have no rims or strokes. Arial is used for headings and controls; Verdana sans-serif is used for explanations and messages. The primary action accent is #0047AB and the exact canvas is #CCCCCC. Eight sections demonstrate primary buttons, button containers, page titles, form inputs, validation, supporting text, status messages, and keyboard hints. Text and shapes are editable; there are no embedded raster images.

metadata.dc:title: Accessible experiment UI design system
metadata.dc:description: Native SVG shapes and editable text. Canvas #CCCCCC. Blue action accent #0047AB. Exact crosshair colors: black #000000, information green #008000, warning red #FF0000. Both i and ! glyphs are white on solid colored circles without rims or strokes. White status banners give the pure-red icon sufficient adjacent contrast. Arial headings/controls; Verdana sans-serif explanations/messages. Keyboard keycaps use only white and grayscale shades. Contrast uses WCAG relative luminance; white/red symbols are 26 px bold, with a 3:1 large-symbol threshold. Static examples illustrate implementation requirements; the card is not an accessibility certification of an application.

g.text: Large type. Quiet surfaces. Blue actions; crosshair status colors.
Focus: 4 px ring + 4 px clear gap
64 px high · 24 px label · 24 px inset · Enter / Space
44 / 54 px · one H1 per page · sentence case
Left align; leave 32 px before page content.
Always show the label and measurement unit.
The value “0” is outside the allowed range.
Name the problem and give a clear correction.
White ! on red; retain the entered value.
Associate the error with its field; announce it.
Sit at a comfortable distance from the screen.
Allow zoom and text reflow without clipping.

g.text: White banners · green i / red ! · no icon outlines
Announce updates politely without moving focus.
White face · gray bevel · raised lower edge
Keep hints near actions; keep focus fully visible.
Body/control text ≥ 4.5 : 1. Focus blue: 5.25 : 1 on #CCCCCC; 6.76 : 1 on #E6E6E6.
Black / white fields: 21 : 1. Gray field edge / panel: 4.60 : 1. Disabled text: 6.03 : 1.
White i / green: 5.14 : 1. White ! / red: 4.00 : 1 (26 px bold). Red / white banner: 4.00 : 1.
Implement semantic headings, labels and buttons; test keyboard use and 200% zoom / 400% reflow.
These are palette checks. Confirm the working interface with assistive technology and users.
Basis: WCAG 2.2 · 1.4.3 Contrast · 1.4.11 Non-text contrast · 2.4.13 Focus appearance
